headline: Copper falls more than 3% as market enthusiasm cools; aluminum hits one-year lows
summary: Copper fell more than 3% on Tuesday, giving up most of the previous session's gains that had been driven by artificial intelligence enthusiasm. Aluminium touched its lowest level in a year.
why: Copper and aluminium are core industrial metals used in construction, power grids and electronics, so their prices reflect global manufacturing demand. They are traded on major exchanges including the London Metal Exchange.
why_moved: Copper gave back most of the prior session's gains as enthusiasm tied to artificial intelligence demand faded, while aluminium weakened to a one-year low.
original_headline: Cobre cae más de 3% por enfriamiento de entusiasmo del mercado; aluminio toca mínimos de un año
